title: Scalar extension preserves finite presentations of internal module objects
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme and give $\mathcal C=\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$ its sheaf tensor product [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. Let $R,S$ be commutative ring objects of $\mathcal C$ [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], and let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a ring-object morphism. For an $R$-module object $M$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], suppose $M$ is finitely presented [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module], meaning that $M\cong\operatorname{coker}(R^m\to R^n)$ for finite $m,n$. Then $\operatorname{Ext}_{\varphi}(M)=S\otimes_R M$ [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] is finitely presented as an $S$-module object. No flatness hypothesis is required.
